description: Import products from a Shopify or WooCommerce/WordPress storefront URL. Paste the public store URL, and Social AI reads Shopify /products.json, WooCommerce public Store API products, or authenticated WooCommerce REST API products when wooConsumerKey/wooConsumerSecret are supplied. Products save as drafts by default so the seller can review before publishing. Use replaceDemoProducts=true to remove template sample products first.

importAs.description: Import visibility. Use draft for beta/review workflows; active only when the user clearly wants products published immediately.

replaceDemoProducts.description: Delete template demo/sample products before importing. Default false.

url.description: Public Shopify/WooCommerce storefront URL, e.g. https://www.example.com, /products.json, or /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products

wooConsumerKey.description: Optional WooCommerce REST API consumer key for private products and full variation imports. Not stored.

wooConsumerSecret.description: Optional WooCommerce REST API consumer secret for private products and full variation imports. Not stored.

name: import_products_from_url
